summary: Batch 5 (Module 5 'Onboard Your New Board Members', My Board dashboard, Engagement Guides, $497 funnel + payment/link audit) — FINAL verification of the 5-batch Recruitment restructure. Created /app/backend/tests/test_batch5_onboard_myboard.py — 19 tests, all pass. Zero Claude generation calls consumed by this suite: all AI verification is done by reading GENERATION_TYPES schemas + prompt notes directly (onboarding_script 11-section Facilitator Guide with correct titles and NEVER-invent clauses; first_board_meeting_invitation with DURING THE MEETING agenda, Board Member Profile conditional section, explicit ban on [Zoom Link]/[To be confirmed] placeholders; board_member_engagement_guide with value/how-to-engage/first-90-days schema and explicit ban on referee/background/protected-characteristics content). Runtime checks: PUT /api/workspace/first-meeting rejects missing date/time/timezone with 422, valid payload persists and is retrieved after re-login. POST /api/payments/diy-checkout returns a Stripe checkout_url and persists amount=49700 / purchase_source='direct_diy_board_recruitment_497'. POST /api/payments/direct-project-checkout persists amount=199700. workspace_routes context-building branches (profile-incomplete vs all-complete) verified via source inspection — no live LLM call needed to validate the two-way branch. UI (Playwright): /recruit-your-board-yourself renders every required piece of copy (hero, 'Build the Board Your Nonprofit Needs', 'What You Will Walk Away With', 'You Are Doing It Yourself...', 'Learn the Process Once...', 'Start Immediately' with 30-minute wording, $497, One payment, No monthly membership, 100% money-back guarantee, MAKE PAYMENT AND START RECRUITING MY BOARD) and CTA takes the user to a real Stripe checkout session at US$497.00 (test mode, sandbox) — payment NOT completed. /recruit-with-rooney renders DO IT YOURSELF/DO IT WITH ME with $497 and $1,997 and no empty href/# anchors; no CURRENT $997 offer on any public funnel page. /board-recruitment-proposal renders and its CTA copy points to $1,997 project. Module 5 UI (logged in as module-tester@example.com) shows exact title 'Onboard Your New Board Members', video fdjjsiEnfWc, first-meeting-panel with all required fields (date/time/timezone/format/meeting_id/passcode/chat/instructions), Generate My Board Onboarding Script card, and 'View My Board' button routing to /app/recruitment/self-guided/results. Regression: five_step_migration.FIVE_STEP_VIDEOS still contains exactly {1..5} and step 5 video is fdjjsiEnfWc. Payment endpoints, refinement_routes, workspace_routes, ai_service and public funnel pages all match the spec.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.GENERATION_TYPES.onboarding_script: schema is a facilitator guide (session_purpose + before_you_begin checklist + 11 fixed section titles matching spec, each with objective/talking_points/suggested_language/discussion_questions). Note text explicitly forbids inventing bylaws/committees/officer roles and enforces board-type-aware adaptation. Spec-aligned.

ai_service.GENERATION_TYPES.first_board_meeting_invitation: subject constrained to 'First Board Meeting | [org]'. Body prompt includes 'DURING THE MEETING, WE WILL:' agenda, conditional 'Please Complete Your Board Member Profile' section (OMIT entirely when all complete), 'Board Meeting Details' listing only supplied fields, and explicit ban on placeholders [Zoom Link]/[Meeting Link]/[To be confirmed]. Matches spec.

ai_service.GENERATION_TYPES.board_member_engagement_guide: per-application internal one-page schema with value areas / how to engage / early responsibilities / relationships-partnerships-fundraising / leadership alignment / first 90 days / evidence-based keep_in_mind. Note explicitly forbids referee responses, background-check data, private interview scoring, protected characteristics, and psychological profiling. 'This guide is internal — never addressed to the member.' Matches spec.

refinement_routes.save_first_meeting (PUT /api/workspace/first-meeting): raises 422 when date/time/timezone missing (verified). GET returns saved payload. FirstMeetingDetails model has all 10 fields including meeting_id, passcode, chat_link, instructions.

workspace_routes.generate for first_board_meeting_invitation: builds context from saved profile.first_meeting (omitting blanks — 'omit anything blank') AND from joined applicants (status='Selected' OR final_outcome='Joined Board'). If ANY joined member lacks a board_profile_responses row, includes 'have NOT completed their Board Member Profile' + first available /board-profile/{token} URL. Otherwise emits 'OMIT the profile section'. Two branches confirmed present in source.

payment_routes.create_diy_checkout persists amount=49700, purchase_source='direct_diy_board_recruitment_497', currency='usd', success_url=/purchase/success (verified). create_direct_project_checkout persists amount=199700, purchase_source='direct_board_recruitment_project'. Both reject invalid origin_url with 400.

Public funnel pages: RecruitYourBoardYourselfPage.jsx contains ALL 12 outcomes + all required section headings + $497 (no $997), MAKE PAYMENT AND START RECRUITING MY BOARD CTA, exact guarantee wording 'Your investment is protected by our 100% money-back guarantee.' RecruitWithRooneyPage exposes DO IT YOURSELF/DO IT WITH ME/$3,997 crossed-out/$1,997 current; no anchors with empty/# href. AboutRooneyPage links $497 -> /recruit-your-board-yourself and $1,997 -> /board-recruitment-proposal.
